More than 40,000 gather as Pope Leo XIV celebrates Mass in Uruguay
contentSnippet: Massive crowds have turned out for the pontiff as he celebrates the first Mass of his South America tour. A nighttime prayer vigil in Montevideo is expected to draw more than 60,000 young people.
